projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Unity project root. Defaults to the Zed workspace root.

endPoint.description: host:port of Unity's Mono SDB debugger, e.g. "127.0.0.1:56286". If omitted, port discovery will attempt to find it automatically.

logFile.description: Optional path to write the debug adapter log file.

adapterPath.description: Absolute path to the debug adapter assembly. .dll files are run via dotnet; .exe files are run natively on Windows or via Mono on Unix.

adapterArgs.description: Extra CLI arguments passed to the adapter executable.
